# AI Chat UI Kit

A Web Components based AI chat UI component library with headless mode support. Cross-framework compatible (React, Vue, vanilla HTML).

Repository: https://github.com/edenxpzhang/ai-chat-ui-kit
NPM Package: @ai-chat/core, @ai-chat/components, @ai-chat/themes
Demo: https://edenxpzhang.github.io/ai-chat-ui-kit/

## Installation

```bash
# Using pnpm (recommended)
pnpm add @ai-chat/core @ai-chat/components @ai-chat/themes

# Using npm
npm install @ai-chat/core @ai-chat/components @ai-chat/themes

# Using yarn
yarn add @ai-chat/core @ai-chat/components @ai-chat/themes
```

## Quick Start

### Vanilla HTML

```html
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
  <meta charset="UTF-8">
  <title>AI Chat Demo</title>
  <script type="module">
    import '@ai-chat/components';
    import '@ai-chat/themes/minimal';
  </script>
</head>
<body>
  <div id="app">
    <ai-chat></ai-chat>
  </div>

  <script>
    const chat = document.querySelector('ai-chat');
    chat.setMessageHandler(async (message) => {
      await new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, 1000));
      return `You said: ${message}`;
    });
  </script>
</body>
</html>
```

### React

```tsx
import React, { useEffect, useRef } from 'react';
import '@ai-chat/components';
import '@ai-chat/themes/minimal';

const ChatApp: React.FC = () => {
  const chatRef = useRef<HTMLElement>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (chatRef.current) {
      (chatRef.current as any).setMessageHandler(async (message: string) => {
        await new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, 1000));
        return `AI response: ${message}`;
      });
    }
  }, []);

  return (
    <div style={{ height: '100vh' }}>
      <ai-chat ref={chatRef}></ai-chat>
    </div>
  );
};

export default ChatApp;
```

### Vue 3

```vue
<template>
  <div style="height: 100vh">
    <ai-chat ref="chatRef"></ai-chat>
  </div>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { ref, onMounted } from 'vue';
import '@ai-chat/components';
import '@ai-chat/themes/minimal';

const chatRef = ref<HTMLElement>();

onMounted(() => {
  if (chatRef.value) {
    (chatRef.value as any).setMessageHandler(async (message: string) => {
      await new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, 1000));
      return `AI response: ${message}`;
    });
  }
});
</script>
```

## Key APIs

### Components Package (@ai-chat/components)

#### `<ai-chat>` Web Component

Main chat container component.

**Methods:**
- `setMessageHandler(handler: (message: string) => Promise<string>): void` - Set AI response handler
- `addMessage(role: 'user' | 'assistant', content: string): void` - Add message programmatically
- `clearMessages(): void` - Clear all messages

**Properties:**
- `placeholder: string` - Input placeholder text
- `disabled: boolean` - Disable input

#### `<ai-message>` Web Component

Individual message component.

**Properties:**
- `role: 'user' | 'assistant'` - Message sender role
- `content: string` - Message content (supports markdown)
- `loading: boolean` - Show loading state

#### `<ai-input>` Web Component

Input component with auto-resize.

**Properties:**
- `placeholder: string` - Placeholder text
- `disabled: boolean` - Disable input
- `value: string` - Input value

#### `<ai-tool-call>` Web Component

Tool call visualization component.

**Properties:**
- `name: string` - Tool name
- `status: 'pending' | 'running' | 'success' | 'error'` - Call status
- `result: any` - Tool execution result

### Core Package (@ai-chat/core)

#### `createChatStore()`

Create chat state management store.

```typescript
import { createChatStore } from '@ai-chat/core';

const store = createChatStore({
  initialState: {
    messages: [],
    loading: false
  }
});
```

#### `createAPIAdapter()`

Create API adapter for different backends.

```typescript
import { createAPIAdapter } from '@ai-chat/core';

const adapter = createAPIAdapter({
  type: 'openai', // or 'anthropic', 'custom'
  apiKey: 'your-api-key',
  model: 'gpt-4'
});
```

#### `createPluginSystem()`

Create plugin system for extending functionality.

```typescript
import { createPluginSystem } from '@ai-chat/core';

const pluginSystem = createPluginSystem();
pluginSystem.register(myPlugin);
```

### Themes Package (@ai-chat/themes)

#### Available Themes

- `minimal` - Minimalist Apple-style, rounded bubbles, blue-white color scheme
- `neon` - Cyberpunk dark theme with neon glow effects
- `glass` - Glassmorphism with translucent blur
- `terminal` - Retro terminal style, green text with scanlines
- `gradient` - Colorful gradient bubbles with pop animations
- `corporate` - Corporate professional style, blue theme

#### Usage

```typescript
// Import theme styles
import '@ai-chat/themes/minimal';
import '@ai-chat/themes/neon';
import '@ai-chat/themes/glass';
import '@ai-chat/themes/terminal';
import '@ai-chat/themes/gradient';
import '@ai-chat/themes/corporate';

// Runtime theme switching
import { applyTheme } from '@ai-chat/themes';
import { minimalTheme } from '@ai-chat/themes/minimal';
import { neonTheme } from '@ai-chat/themes/neon';

applyTheme(minimalTheme);
applyTheme(neonTheme);
```

## Headless Mode

Use only the logic layer without UI components.

```typescript
import { createChatStore } from '@ai-chat/core';

const store = createChatStore();

// Subscribe to state changes
store.subscribe((state) => {
  console.log('Messages:', state.messages);
  console.log('Loading:', state.loading);
});

// Dispatch actions
store.dispatch({ type: 'ADD_MESSAGE', payload: { role: 'user', content: 'Hello' } });
store.dispatch({ type: 'SET_LOADING', payload: true });
```

## Plugin System

Create custom plugins to extend functionality.

```typescript
import { createPluginSystem, Plugin } from '@ai-chat/core';

const myPlugin: Plugin = {
  name: 'my-plugin',
  install: (context) => {
    // Access chat store
    const store = context.getStore();
    
    // Add custom behavior
    store.subscribe((state) => {
      console.log('State changed:', state);
    });
  }
};

const pluginSystem = createPluginSystem();
pluginSystem.register(myPlugin);
```

## API Adapters

Built-in adapters for popular AI APIs.

```typescript
import { createAPIAdapter } from '@ai-chat/core';

// OpenAI
const openai = createAPIAdapter({
  type: 'openai',
  apiKey: process.env.OPENAI_API_KEY,
  model: 'gpt-4'
});

// Anthropic
const anthropic = createAPIAdapter({
  type: 'anthropic',
  apiKey: process.env.ANTHROPIC_API_KEY,
  model: 'claude-3'
});

// Custom
const custom = createAPIAdapter({
  type: 'custom',
  endpoint: 'https://your-api.com/chat',
  headers: { 'Authorization': 'Bearer token' }
});
```

## TypeScript Support

Full TypeScript support with complete type definitions.

```typescript
import type { ChatStore, Message, Theme } from '@ai-chat/core';
import type { AIChat, AIMessage } from '@ai-chat/components';

// Type-safe component usage
const chat = document.querySelector('ai-chat') as AIChat;
chat.setMessageHandler(async (message: string): Promise<string> => {
  return 'Response';
});

// Type-safe store usage
const store: ChatStore = createChatStore();
const messages: Message[] = store.getState().messages;
```

## Styling

Customize component styles with CSS custom properties.

```css
ai-chat {
  --ai-chat-bg: #f5f5f5;
  --ai-chat-user-bubble-bg: #007aff;
  --ai-chat-assistant-bubble-bg: #ffffff;
  --ai-chat-text-color: #333333;
  --ai-chat-font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif;
}
```

## Browser Support

- Chrome/Edge 90+
- Firefox 90+
- Safari 14+
- Requires ES2020 support
